title: Recovery code
description: The 12-symbol, 60-bit code the user owns. Hyphens are canonical; normalization folds the characters that look alike.

code.description: Canonical display form, uppercase, with hyphens. Note: the alphabet excludes I, L, O and U.

$comment: The pattern is a display-form check. A reader MUST normalize first (uppercase, strip separators, O->0, I/L->1, U->V) and then validate the 12 normalized symbols.
